name: Aldrassil
summary: Young kaldorei gather beneath Aldrassil’s vast boughs in Shadowglen. The settlement shelters trainers, merchants, and local leaders in hollows carved through the great tree.

sections.title: Heart of Shadowglen
sections.body: Aldrassil shelters young night elves in Shadowglen. Ramps wind through its immense trunk, passing trainers and artisans on the way to the high roost. Tenaron Stormgrip watches over the glade’s protection from there. Beyond the tree, Teldrassil stretches across the horizon, while novices learn their arts beneath Aldrassil’s canopy before venturing into Kalimdor’s troubled wilds.

faq.answer: Aldrassil shelters young night elves at the heart of Shadowglen, in northeastern Teldrassil. Its hollowed trunk holds a settlement where they find training, goods, and guidance.

faq.q: Who leads the settlement at Aldrassil?
faq.answer: Tenaron Stormgrip oversees Shadowglen from his roost atop Aldrassil. He coordinates the vale’s defense and guides newly awakened kaldorei.

faq.q: What services can be found here?
faq.answer: Aldrassil’s trainers teach young night elf warriors, rogues, druids, hunters, and priests. Supply merchants and armorers also serve the glade’s immediate needs.

angles.text: For many young kaldorei, Aldrassil’s carved hollows and ramps are their first memory of civic life and the start of their training.
As a druid, you can see the kaldorei affinity for living architecture in Aldrassil, shaped from living wood while keeping the forest’s balance.
